selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Where did the traveler arrive in this passage?
questions.answer: He came to the school of Imam Rabbani, Ahmad Faruqi.

questions.question: What does the Imam call the most important result of Sufi paths?
questions.answer: He calls it the clear opening of the truths of belief.

questions.question: What had earlier great people said would happen in the future?
questions.answer: They said a scholar would appear who would prove the truths of Islam and belief with strong reason.

questions.question: What four things did the Imam say belief and tawhid are for human perfection?
questions.answer: They are its foundation, its substance, its light, and its life.

questions.question: What place do belief and tawhid hold in human perfection?
questions.answer: They hold the central place as its base, content, light, and life.

questions.question: What kind of remembrance in that order is mentioned?
questions.answer: A quiet, unspoken remembrance is mentioned.

questions.question: Why does the traveler say believers should strengthen their faith?
questions.answer: Because faith is the key and base for everlasting happiness, eternal life, and Paradise.

questions.question: Why are those pillars so important?
questions.answer: They are the key and foundation of everlasting joy, endless life, and Paradise.

questions.question: How many strong degrees of faith had already been found?
questions.answer: Twenty-nine had already been found.

questions.question: What name of Allah did he mention when opening the gate?
questions.answer: He called on Allah as the Opener.

questions.question: Who was giving the lesson the traveler heard?
questions.answer: Imam Rabbani, Ahmad Faruqi, was giving the lesson.

questions.question: What does the lesson say is the biggest gain from Sufi paths?
questions.answer: The biggest gain is that the truths of faith become clear and unfolded.

questions.question: What had some earlier great scholars reportedly said?
questions.answer: They had said someone would come who could prove the truths of Islam and belief very clearly.

questions.question: According to the Imam, what are belief and tawhid for all human perfection?
questions.answer: They are the foundation, essence, light, and life of it.

questions.question: How carefully did the traveler pay attention to the lesson?
questions.answer: He paid very close attention.

questions.question: What group does the traveler warn against?
questions.answer: He warns against philosophers in Europe who oppose faith and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are they trying to damage?
questions.answer: They are trying to damage the pillars of belief.

questions.question: What was the traveler’s next goal in number?
questions.answer: His next goal was thirty-three.

questions.question: What image does the traveler use for entering the next lesson?
questions.answer: He speaks of knocking on a door and opening a gate.

questions.question: What important Muslim teacher appears in this passage?
questions.answer: Imam Rabbani, Ahmad Faruqi, appears in it.

questions.question: What did the Imam say is better than many miracles and spiritual visions?
questions.answer: Clearly understanding even one truth of faith is better.

questions.question: What had former great people said would happen?
questions.answer: They said someone would rise from scholars of theology to prove the truths of belief and Islam.

questions.question: What correction does the note later make?
questions.answer: It says the real answer to that hope was the Risale-i Nur as a work.

questions.question: What group does the traveler describe as working against faith?
questions.answer: He describes some European philosophers that way.
